# Current Objective

Extend export CSV projection and null rendering while preserving default CSV/JSON behavior

# Completed

- Inspected schema.py, csv_export.py, json_export.py, cli.py, and public tests.
- Centralized schema projection in schema.values_for and updated both writers to use it.
- Added CSV delimiter/columns validation before opening destinations, column projection, null rendering, and CLI options.
- Confirmed public test suite passes.

# Decisions

- Centralize ordered field-to-row-cell projection in schema; CSV validates delimiter/columns before destination open, while JSON ignores CSV-only settings.
- JSON writer remains insulated from CSV-only options; CSV uses csv.writer standard quoting with UTF-8 streams.

# Next Suggested Step

Review final diff and hand off completed work.
